items.headline: Council scheduled Environmental Planning Commission applicant interviews for Oct. 20
items.summary: The City Council's October 20 study session agenda listed interviews of applicants for the Environmental Planning Commission, the advisory body that reviews land use and development matters.

items.headline: Council agenda lists approach for leasing city-owned property on Stevens Creek
items.summary: The October 20 City Council agenda included a item on a proposed approach for leasing the City-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard. The agenda text shows only the subject line, not lease terms or any decision.

items.headline: Station Area task force agenda: draft specific plan and Benton-Brokaw crossing study
items.summary: The October 15 Station Area Task Force agenda listed the task force's review of the complete draft Specific Plan for the Santa Clara Station area. It also listed a public hearing on the Benton-Brokaw Multimodal Crossing Feasibility Study.

items.headline: AT&T seeks to add antennas to utility poles near Guinda and Homer
items.summary: The Architectural Review Board's October 15 agenda listed AT&T's request to collocate antennas, radio units and seven-foot fiberglass pole extensions on two city-owned wood utility poles in the public right-of-way. The poles are near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue. The agenda lists the project as exempt from CEQA review as an existing-facilities project.

items.headline: San José Council agenda: El Niño, Anderson Dam, Pure Water updates
items.summary: The October 13 City Council agenda listed a joint update on El Niño preparedness for the 2026-2027 rainy season. It also listed updates on the Anderson Dam Seismic Retrofit and Coyote Creek Flood Protection projects, and on the Pure Water Silicon Valley potable reuse project.

items.headline: Housing Element incentives to tilt redevelopment toward homes over offices
items.summary: The October 13 agenda listed a discussion and possible recommendation to the City Council on Housing Element Program 3.9A. The program aims to identify incentives at strategic locations that shift the economic benefit of redevelopment from commercial uses toward home building.

items.headline: Council agenda lists release of documents on Cubberley purchase offer
items.summary: The October 13 City Council agenda included an item on the potential release of documents related to an offer to purchase the Cubberley Community Center property. The agenda gave no further details on the offer.

items.headline: Peery Park plan amendment would add office, R&D, housing and move water tower
items.summary: The October 12 special Planning Commission study session agenda listed a proposed amendment to the Peery Park Specific Plan to increase office and R&D square footage and residential units, and to allow relocation of the Libby Water Tower. The same session was a scoping meeting for public comments on a Notice of Preparation for a Supplemental EIR to the 2016 Peery Park plan EIR.
